description: Use this when the user shares an Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook post or video link and wants its transcript, a breakdown of why it worked, or their own version of it. XcutAI transcribes the video and reads the caption, visuals and stats. Don't ask which canvas: with none named it goes to the user's "From AI apps" canvas. A fraction of a credit plus transcription (1-2 credits for a short video). Returns a `job_id`; xcut_get_job returns the transcript when done. Do not use for website links (use xcut_import_website) or Meta Ad Library links (use xcut_import_meta_ad).

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id
